title: Feadship's 101-Meter Project 1014 Commences Sea Trials
description: Feadship's 101.2-meter superyacht Project 1014 has begun sea trials in the North Sea, marking a significant milestone for the Dutch shipyard.
html:
The Highly Anticipated Superyacht Embarks On Her Maiden Voyages In The North Sea

Dutch shipyard Feadship has officially announced that its impressive 101.2-meter superyacht Project 1014 has embarked on sea trials in the North Sea, a critical phase before her anticipated delivery. This development follows her grand launch from the shipyard’s Makkum facilities on April 1st, an event that garnered significant attention within the luxury yachting community. The vessel represents another pinnacle of engineering and design from the renowned builder. The journey to this point has been marked by a veil of secrecy, a characteristic often associated with such prestigious projects. Project 1014 had previously entered the outfitting sheds in November 2024 and had only been observed a handful of times since construction commenced in early 2023. This period of intense development and meticulous craftsmanship underscores Feadship’s commitment to delivering exceptional vessels.

Unveiling more details at her launch, Feadship confirmed that the exterior styling of Project 1014 was masterfully conceived by the British studio RWD, known for its elegant and innovative designs. Naval architecture was skillfully developed by Azure Yacht Design & Naval Architecture, ensuring both aesthetic appeal and optimal performance. While her interior remains a private sanctuary, it is also a collaborative effort between RWD and the esteemed Parisian studio Chahan Interior Design, promising a blend of British sophistication and French artistry. Project 1014 immediately captivates with her striking dark, navy-blue hull, beautifully contrasted by a tall, crisp white superstructure. Her profile is distinguished by generous overhangs, a classic, broad bow, and intricately sculpted hull windows that enhance her sleek lines. The shipyard also highlighted subtle brass detailing integrated throughout her exterior, elements chosen to impart a sense of warmth and refined elegance to her powerful presence on the water. These carefully considered exterior lines draw graceful comparisons to other notable Feadship creations, including Tango and Defy. The yacht also echoes the sophisticated design ethos seen in Sophia, formerly Faith, and her more recent predecessor, Faith, both of which were also artfully penned by RWD, showcasing a consistent thread of design excellence within the Feadship fleet. Among her most luxurious features, the main deck aft hosts a large, glass-bottomed swimming pool, designed to cast shimmering light into the beach club situated below. This beach club, a haven of relaxation and entertainment, is further enhanced by multiple fold-down balconies that extend over the water. A spacious helipad is thoughtfully integrated on the foredeck, catering to the owner’s private aviation needs. Crowning the superyacht is a forward-facing Jacuzzi and an interior living area, both boasting additional curved windows that offer panoramic views and abundant natural light. With an estimated volume of 3,840 gross tons, Project 1014 is a testament to expansive luxury, though further specifics of her lavish accommodations remain discreetly private.

Feadship continues to solidify its position at the forefront of the superyacht industry, with Project 1014 being a shining example of their current portfolio. The Dutch yard presently has 17 yachts either on order or actively under construction, demonstrating a robust order book and unwavering demand for their bespoke creations. Project 1014 stands as the second-largest vessel within this impressive pipeline, with attention already turning to their new 140-meter flagship, whose bow was recently sighted by yacht enthusiasts last month.

The successful initiation of sea trials for Project 1014 marks a significant milestone not only for Feadship but also for the broader luxury yacht market. This phase is crucial for testing the vessel’s performance, stability, and advanced systems, ensuring she meets the exacting standards expected of a Feadship yacht. Her impending delivery will undoubtedly add another magnificent masterpiece to the world’s elite superyacht fleet, ready to offer unparalleled charter experiences through FYI Yachts to discerning clients.
